subject: 📅 Health appointment booked - $appointment_date at $appointment_time (Ref #$appointment_id)
body:
Dear $student_name,

Your appointment with the University Health Centre has been booked. This email confirms what has been recorded — please check the details below.

=== YOUR APPOINTMENT ===
Reference Number: $appointment_id
Type: $appointment_type
Date: $appointment_date
Time: $appointment_time
Provider: $provider
Status: $status
Booked On: $scheduled_at

=== REASON FOR THE APPOINTMENT ===
$reason

=== NOTES ===
$notes

=== BEFORE YOU COME ===
1. Arrive 15 minutes early so we can check you in.
2. Bring your student ID and a list of any medication you are taking.
3. Tell us on arrival if your symptoms have changed since you booked.

=== IF YOU CANNOT ATTEND ===
Please cancel or rearrange at least 24 hours in advance so the slot can be offered to someone else. You can do this through the Health Portal or by contacting the Health Centre.

=== IF SOMETHING IS WRONG ===
If any detail above is incorrect, or you did not book this appointment, contact the Health Centre quoting reference $appointment_id.

=== CONTACT INFORMATION ===
Health Centre: health@university.edu
Phone: (555) 123-4567
Office Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM
Out of hours emergencies: call 999

Best regards,
University Health Centre

$signature
